name: gateway-health-diagnostic
title: Add gateway-health diagnostic subcommand
description: Add a read-only gateway-health command to aidev_tuios.py that shows gateway tier health and the tier_online decision. This diagnostic helps verify that the gateway is the only source for tiers 1-4.

userStories.title: gateway-health command
userStories.description: Add cmd_gateway_health function and register it in main. The function prints key sources, probe key file status, gateway groups with health status, and tier-N lines for tier-1 through tier-4. Register it next to tiers in main.
acceptanceCriteria: python3 .config/aistack-tuios/aidev_tuios.py gateway-health exits 0 and prints a key sources line, a probe key file line, and one line starting tier-1, tier-2, tier-3 and tier-4
